purpose: program-level test of an attenuated secretory-phase stromal program in eutopic endometrium of endometriosis donors (progesterone-resistance hypothesis), using the frozen phase positive-control fits as the signature and the positive-control count matrices as the data; no v1 or positive-control artifact is modified

hypothesis.statement: among secretory-phase donors, the proliferative-to-secretory stromal program is less fully expressed in endometriosis than in non-endometriosis eutopic endometrium
hypothesis.primary_estimand: theta: the phase-by-disease interaction on the donor-level program projection score (difference between the ENDO and non-ENDO secretory shifts, each relative to the cohort's proliferative donors)

heca.hash_source: receipts/phase_positive_control_evaluation.json:artifacts; normalization and design through their published byte copies reports/phase_positive_control_f2/heca_de_normalization.tsv and heca_de_design.tsv

identity_checks.expression_filter: recomputed edgeR::filterByExpr with the phase group must equal the frozen expression_pass column exactly
identity_checks.normalization: recomputed TMM factors and filtered library sizes must equal the frozen normalization table within the relative tolerance
identity_checks.design: the rebuilt positive-control primary design must equal the frozen design table within the design tolerance, same columns and donor order
identity_checks.own_table_family: the test cohort's frozen phase table must list exactly the recomputed expression-pass genes

signature.definition: genes with fit_estimable TRUE and BH q below q_threshold in the signature cohort's frozen SEC_minus_PRO table, restricted to genes in the test cohort's expression-pass family
signature.weights: signature cohort's SEC_minus_PRO log2 fold change beta_g; sign(beta_g) for the equal-weight score and the set test
signature.own_cohort_program_sensitivity: the test cohort's own q<0.05 program, selected on the same donors; reported as circular and never used for a label

score.expression: log2((count + 0.5) / (filtered library size x TMM factor + 1) x 1e6), the voom log-CPM, on the expression-pass genes of the test cohort
score.reference: per gene, the arithmetic mean over the cohort's proliferative donors (the v1 arm)
score.primary: projection = sum_g beta_g (x_gd - m_g) / sum_g beta_g^2 over signature genes in the family; 1 corresponds to the signature cohort's full phase shift
score.secondary: mean_signed_shift = mean_g sign(beta_g) (x_gd - m_g), in log2 units

M0_gate.design: positive-control primary design: intercept, SEC_minus_PRO, ENDO_minus_non_ENDO, age_centered_years, batch treatment contrasts, adenomyosis

M1_primary.design: positive-control primary design plus SEC_x_ENDO = SEC_minus_PRO x ENDO_minus_non_ENDO

M2_secretory.design: intercept, ENDO_minus_non_ENDO, age_centered_years centered on the secretory donors

M2_subphase.design: M2_secretory plus sub-phase treatment contrasts versus the first level present in the configured order

sensitivities_of_M1.own_cohort_program: M1 on the projection onto the test cohort's own program (circular)
sensitivities_of_M1.depth_minimum: M1 after excluding donors below depth_minimum primary cells or nuclei
sensitivities_of_M1.adenomyosis_excluded: M1 after excluding adenomyosis = 1 donors; the adenomyosis column is then dropped as constant
sensitivities_of_M1.leave_one_donor_out: M1 refitted without each donor in turn; range of theta and the largest absolute change

models.age_center: arithmetic mean of the donors entering each model
models.not_estimable_policy: rank deficiency, residual df below the minimum or no batch containing both phases yields NOT_ESTIMABLE for that model; no relaxation

gene_level.estimator: v1 estimator as copied in scripts/mde_lib.R (mde_fit_subset) with the phase group; BH over the expression-pass family

set_test.direction_meaning: Down means the program is attenuated in ENDO

program_statistics: beta-weighted projection of the interaction log2 fold changes
mean signed interaction log2 fold change
share of signature genes whose interaction sign opposes beta
gene_level.role: secondary; gene-wise results are published but are not a shortlist

mde.from: realized standard error and residual df of each estimated model; two-sided noncentral t, solver as in config/mde_analysis.json

per_cohort.no_detectable_difference: otherwise, with the 95% interval and the MDE reported as the bound

pair.replicated_attenuation: theta < 0 with two-sided p < 0.05 in both cohorts
pair.replicated_enhancement: theta > 0 with two-sided p < 0.05 in both cohorts
pair.single_cohort_signal: exactly one cohort at p < 0.025, in either direction, and not replicated
pair.no_detectable_difference: neither cohort at p < 0.025 and not replicated
pair.NOT_EVALUABLE: a cohort is NOT_INTERPRETABLE or NOT_ESTIMABLE; the other cohort's label is reported alone
